SUMMARY5+ years of expertise designingand developing data applicationsusing PySpark, AWS, Databricks,AWS Glue,S3,Athena, and SparkSQL within the Hadoopecosystem.•14 years of total experienceacross Azure,AWS,DataBricks,SnowFlake, Hadoop, Big Data,Power BI, Talend ETL, andproduction support, with strongskills in building and optimizinglarge-scale data pipelines.•Led a 12-member team,managing project delivery,mentoring engineers, andensuring high-quality, scalabledata solutions.•

SKILLSPySpark and Hadoop•Python programming•Cloud computing (Azure andAWS)•Databricks expertise•SnowFlake•Problem solving•Performance monitoring•Data modeling•Data migration strategies•Airflow orchestration•Project management•SQL proficiency•Jira management•Machine learning fundamentals•VIKASKUMARSINGH

EXPERIENCENovember 2020 - CurrentAssociate Manager| PySpark Lead |Cloud Migration|AccentureServices Pvt. Ltd. | BangaloreJune 2019 - October 2020Data Engineering Lead| AZURE Data Engineer|Accenture ServicePvt. Ltd.October 2017 - June 2019Lead Analyst |CGIBusiness StatementThe customer required a full migration of their on-premises data andanalytics platform to a scalable cloud environment. The objective wasto significantly enhance system performance, processing speed, andDesigned and executed scalable data pipelines using PySpark andDatabricks on AWS (EMR), boosting data processing performanceby 40% to enable real-time analytics and data-driven decision-making.•Developed and maintained ETL workflows in AWS Glue, integratingdata from multiple on-premises sources into centralized datarepositories.•Led a team of 12–15 data engineers, optimizing end-to-end dataworkflows and significantly improving overall processing efficiency.•Collaborated closely with business stakeholders to define datarequirements, ensure data accuracy, and maintain high data integritystandards.Key Achievements•Achieved a 40% reduction in data processing time by optimizingPySpark jobs and improving pipeline performance.•Directed the migration of a legacy data warehouse to AWS,enhancing system scalability, reliability, and maintainability whilerealizing a 30% reduction in operational costs and streamliningcross-departmental migration activities.•Possess extensive Azure-based data engineering expertise,covering end-to-end management of data pipelines, productionsupport, data modeling, and release management; successfullydelivered 20 major releases with an 80% on-time delivery rate.•Led Scrum-driven sprint teams, translating business requirementsinto precise user stories, coordinating development efforts, andensuring high-quality deliverables with over 95% defect-freeperformance.•Proficient in a wide range of Azure tools and services, includingAzure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Virtual Machines,Azure Synapse Analytics (Serverless & Dedicated SQL Pools),Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, and PowerBI; highly skilled in Spark, Python, Scala, and workflow orchestrationplatforms such as Apache Airflow.•

delivery capacity while modernizing the existing data ecosystem.SolutionWe designed and developed a scalable, cloud-native data andanalytics platform on Microsoft Azure. The solution included buildingreusable PySpark-based data processing frameworks and executingthe end-to-end migration of workflows from the on-premises Hiveenvironment to Azure services. Leveraged Azure Data Lake Storage(ADLS Gen2) for scalable storage, Azure Databricks for distributedprocessing, and Azure Data Factory for orchestrating ingestion andtransformation pipelines.October 2015 - October 2017Senior Software Engineer|WiproJune 2011 - October 2015Production Support Engineer|Accenture Service Pvt Ltd.Gathered and analyzed business and technical requirements todesign the overall data ingestion and transformation solution.•Performed end-to-end data engineering activities, includingingestion, processing, transformation, and validation across the datalifecycle.•Collected data from RDBMS sources using Sqoop and ingested itinto HDFS for downstream processing.•Developed and optimized Hive scripts, queries, and action workflowsto implement transformation logic and ensure data quality.•Developed ETL jobs using Talend Studio, performed unit testing, anddeployed the jobs to the Talend Production Server following releasemanagement practices.•Configured and monitored job scheduling through Control-M,ensuring timely execution, handling reruns, and managing jobdependencies.•Collaborated with Business, QA, and Operations teams to supporttesting, perform defect resolution, and ensure smooth deploymentinto production.•

CERTIFICATIONSAWS Data Analytics Specialty•AWS Certified Database - Specialty•GCP Professional Data Engineer•AZ-204: Azure Developing Solutions•Databricks Professional Data Engineer•

EDUCATION2024M Tech| Data Science & Data EngineeringBITS Pilani2011B TECH| Electrical & Electronics EngineeringAmrita University, India

WEBSITES, PORTFOLIOS AND PROFILES

https://www.linkedin.com/in/vikas-kumar-singh-124b1085/

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
EXPERIENCENovember 2020 - CurrentAssociate Manager| PySpark Lead |Cloud Migration|AccentureServices Pvt. Ltd. | BangaloreJune 2019 - October 2020Data Engineering Lead| AZURE Data Engineer|Accenture ServicePvt. Ltd.October 2017 - June 2019Lead Analyst |CGIBusiness StatementThe customer required a full migration of their on-premises data andanalytics platform to a scalable cloud environment. The objective wasto significantly enhance system performance, processing speed, andDesigned and executed scalable data pipelines using PySpark andDatabricks on AWS (EMR), boosting data processing performanceby 40% to enable real-time analytics and data-driven decision-making.•Developed and maintained ETL workflows in AWS Glue, integratingdata from multiple on-premises sources into centralized datarepositories.•Led a team of 12–15 data engineers, optimizing end-to-end dataworkflows and significantly improving overall processing efficiency.•Collaborated closely with business stakeholders to define datarequirements, ensure data accuracy, and maintain high data integritystandards.Key Achievements•Achieved a 40% reduction in data processing time by optimizingPySpark jobs and improving pipeline performance.•Directed the migration of a legacy data warehouse to AWS,enhancing system scalability, reliability, and maintainability whilerealizing a 30% reduction in operational costs and streamliningcross-departmental migration activities.•Possess extensive Azure-based data engineering expertise,covering end-to-end management of data pipelines, productionsupport, data modeling, and release management; successfullydelivered 20 major releases with an 80% on-time delivery rate.•Led Scrum-driven sprint teams, translating business requirementsinto precise user stories, coordinating development efforts, andensuring high-quality deliverables with over 95% defect-freeperformance.•Proficient in a wide range of Azure tools and services, includingAzure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Virtual Machines,Azure Synapse Analytics (Serverless & Dedicated SQL Pools),Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, and PowerBI; highly skilled in Spark, Python, Scala, and workflow orchestrationplatforms such as Apache Airflow.•
delivery capacity while modernizing the existing data ecosystem.SolutionWe designed and developed a scalable, cloud-native data andanalytics platform on Microsoft Azure. The solution included buildingreusable PySpark-based data processing frameworks and executingthe end-to-end migration of workflows from the on-premises Hiveenvironment to Azure services. Leveraged Azure Data Lake Storage(ADLS Gen2) for scalable storage, Azure Databricks for distributedprocessing, and Azure Data Factory for orchestrating ingestion andtransformation pipelines.October 2015 - October 2017Senior Software Engineer|WiproJune 2011 - October 2015Production Support Engineer|Accenture Service Pvt Ltd.Gathered and analyzed business and technical requirements todesign the overall data ingestion and transformation solution.•Performed end-to-end data engineering activities, includingingestion, processing, transformation, and validation across the datalifecycle.•Collected data from RDBMS sources using Sqoop and ingested itinto HDFS for downstream processing.•Developed and optimized Hive scripts, queries, and action workflowsto implement transformation logic and ensure data quality.•Developed ETL jobs using Talend Studio, performed unit testing, anddeployed the jobs to the Talend Production Server following releasemanagement practices.•Configured and monitored job scheduling through Control-M,ensuring timely execution, handling reruns, and managing jobdependencies.•Collaborated with Business, QA, and Operations teams to supporttesting, perform defect resolution, and ensure smooth deploymentinto production.•
